response.sql: WITH scan_with_site AS (SELECT s.questregistry, s.scancount, s.gbsize, s.spanmin, sites.healtheval, CASE WHEN s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin > 0 THEN s.gbsize / s.spanmin ELSE NULL END AS gb_per_minute FROM scans s INNER JOIN sites ON s.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry), status_rates AS (SELECT healtheval, SUM(scancount) AS total_scancount, AVG(gb_per_minute) AS rate FROM scan_with_site GROUP BY healtheval), overall_avg_rate AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM status_rates) SELECT sr.healtheval, sr.total_scancount, sr.rate, sr.rate - oar.avg_rate AS rate_minus_avg FROM status_rates sr CROSS JOIN overall_avg_rate oar WHERE sr.rate > oar.avg_rate ORDER BY sr.healtheval;
